verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only the open-source Relay Proxy running on customer infrastructure, and it still connects to LaunchDarkly's streaming API. That is an adjacent component, not a self-hosted distribution of the full flag platform, and the federal instance is a vendor-run FedRAMP environment rather than self-hosting.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can self-host the full flag platform from an open-source distribution, keeping evaluation data on my infrastructure

citations.quote: a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients
LaunchDarkly has an open source 'Relay' you can run in your own environment for extra resiliency.
